import subprocess, hashlib, json, re, time, urllib.parse as up
from pathlib import Path

DATA_DIR = Path('tasks/t0103_extract_baden_2016_ds_morphologies/data')
COOKIE_JAR = DATA_DIR / '.cookies_readme'
if COOKIE_JAR.exists():
    COOKIE_JAR.unlink()

UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'

def solve_pow(challenge_data: str, difficulty: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
    half = difficulty // 2
    odd = difficulty % 2 != 0
    nonce = 0
    while True:
        h = hashlib.sha256(f'{challenge_data}{nonce}'.encode()).digest()
        ok = True
        for s in range(half):
            if h[s] != 0:
                ok = False
                break
        if ok and odd and (h[half] >> 4) != 0:
            ok = False
        if ok:
            return h.hex(), nonce
        nonce += 1

def curl(url, *extra, decode=True):
    cmd = [
        'curl', '-sS', '-L', '-b', str(COOKIE_JAR), '-c', str(COOKIE_JAR),
        '-A', UA,
        '-H', 'Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8',
        '-H', 'Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9',
        '-H', 'Cache-Control: no-cache',
        '-H', 'Pragma: no-cache',
        '--compressed',
        *extra,
        url,
    ]
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    if decode:
        try:
            return r.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), r.returncode, r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
        except Exception:
            return r.stdout, r.returncode, r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')
    return r.stdout, r.returncode, r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')

# Use a completely fresh session with curl's TLS fingerprint
print('Step 1: visit dataset page (warm-up)')
body, rc, err = curl('https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38')
print(f'  rc={rc}, len={len(body)}, is_html={"DOCTYPE html" in body[:100]}')
time.sleep(5)

print('Step 2: GET file_stream/3407')
target = 'https://datadryad.org/downloads/file_stream/3407'
body, rc, err = curl(target, '-H', 'Referer: https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38')
print(f'  rc={rc}, len={len(body)}')
print(f'  first 200: {body[:200]!r}')

is_anubis = 'anubis_challenge' in body
is_waf = 'awsWafCookie' in body or 'AwsWafIntegration' in body
is_pdf = body[:4] == '%PDF' if isinstance(body, str) else body[:4] == b'%PDF'
print(f'  is_anubis={is_anubis}, is_waf={is_waf}, is_pdf={is_pdf}')

if is_anubis:
    m = re.search(r'<script id="anubis_challenge" type="application/json">(.+?)</script>', body, re.DOTALL)
    ch_data = json.loads(m.group(1).strip())
    ch = ch_data['challenge']
    t0 = time.time()
    hash_hex, nonce = solve_pow(ch['randomData'], ch_data['rules']['difficulty'])
    elapsed_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    print(f'  PoW solved: nonce={nonce}, {elapsed_ms}ms')
    params = {'id': ch['id'], 'response': hash_hex, 'nonce': str(nonce), 'redir': target, 'elapsedTime': str(elapsed_ms)}
    pass_url = 'https://datadryad.org/.within.website/x/cmd/anubis/api/pass-challenge?' + up.urlencode(params)
    # Use --max-redirs 0 to capture the cookie response
    body2, rc2, err2 = curl(pass_url, '-H', 'Referer: ' + target, '--max-redirs', '0', '-w', '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}')
    print(f'  pass-challenge: rc={rc2}, body[:80]={body2[:80]!r}')
    time.sleep(3)
    print('Step 3: re-fetch')
    body, rc, err = curl(target, '-H', 'Referer: https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.d9v38', '-o', str(DATA_DIR / 'tmp_readme.bin'), '-w', 'HTTP=%{http_code} URL=%{url_effective} SIZE=%{size_download}', decode=True)
    print(f'  rc={rc}, body[:300]={body[:300]!r}')
    tmp_path = DATA_DIR / 'tmp_readme.bin'
    if tmp_path.exists():
        data = tmp_path.read_bytes()
        print(f'  saved len={len(data)}, first 16={data[:16]!r}')
        if data[:4] == b'%PDF':
            out = DATA_DIR / 'README_for_BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.pdf'
            tmp_path.rename(out)
            sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
            print(f'\nSUCCESS: {out} {len(data)} bytes sha256={sha}')
        else:
            print(f'\nFAIL: not a PDF, content preview:')
            print(data[:1500].decode(errors='replace'))
            tmp_path.unlink()
